hero.badge: Fun quizzes • Free • Together or solo
hero.title: Our fun quizzes for couples
hero.description: These quizzes are games to play as a couple and they don't measure anything serious. For example, you can find out what dog or what kind of house would suit your couple. There are also quizzes for Halloween and for Christmas.

halloween.intro: Here are 5 quizzes to take on Halloween night. For example, you can find out how long you'd survive in a horror movie or which supervillain you're most like. It's all for fun and each quiz takes about five minutes.

noel.intro: Here are 2 quizzes to take on a December evening. The first one tells you which of Santa's lists your couple is on. The second one tells you which Christmas characters you make. You each answer separately and you get a single result for your couple, with its photo.

quiz.quizSerialKillerNom: Which serial killer are you compatible with?
quiz.quizSerialKillerTagline: You answer 15 situations from a Halloween night and the quiz tells you which famous killer you're most like.
quiz.quizMortFilmHorreurNom: Which of us dies first in a horror movie?
quiz.quizMortFilmHorreurTagline: You answer 15 situations from a horror movie and the quiz works out your survival time in minutes. As a couple, it tells you who dies first.
quiz.quizPossessionNom: Which of us could get possessed?
quiz.quizPossessionTagline: You spend ten days in a haunted house and the quiz works out your risk of possession as a percentage. As a couple, it tells you who the demons would pick.
quiz.quizSuperVilainNom: Which supervillain are you most like?
quiz.quizSuperVilainTagline: You answer 15 situations from a Halloween party and the quiz tells you which supervillain you're most like, for example the Joker or Maleficent.
quiz.quizDuoVilainsTagline: You plan the Halloween night heist. The quiz gives each of you a role, for example the brains or the muscle. Then it tells you which famous villain duo you form.
quiz.quizChienNousTagline: You each answer 12 questions and the quiz shows you the dog that would suit your couple, with its photo.
quiz.quizMaisonNousNom: What kind of house should we live in?
quiz.quizMaisonNousTagline: You each answer 12 questions about the life you picture and the quiz shows you your home as a couple in a photo.
quiz.quizOuVivreNom: Where should we live in 10 years?
quiz.quizOuVivreTagline: You each answer 12 questions about the life you picture and the quiz shows you your place as a couple in a photo.
quiz.quizMariageNousNom: What kind of wedding should we have?
quiz.quizMariageNousTagline: You each answer 12 questions about the wedding day and the quiz shows you your wedding as a couple in a photo.
quiz.quizListeNoelTagline: You each answer 12 questions about your December. The quiz tells you if your couple is on the nice list and who is the nicer one.
quiz.quizDuoNoelTagline: You each answer 12 questions about how you celebrate Christmas and the quiz gives you the duo you make, with its photo.
quiz.quizPorteCulotteTagline: You answer 20 questions to find out who decides in your relationship. Together, the quiz also shows you the questions where you disagree.
quiz.quizAnimauxNousTagline: You each answer 12 questions about your life together and the quiz shows you your animal couple in a photo.
quiz.quizPartenairesNousNom: What kind of partners are we?
quiz.quizPartenairesNousTagline: You each answer 12 questions about everyday life and the quiz shows you your kind of partners in a photo.

section1.title: What these quizzes are for
section1.p1: The quizzes on this page are nothing like our couple tests. They don't measure anything serious and they don't give your relationship a score. They're games. For example, you can find out what dog would suit your couple or who gets the last word at your place.
section1.p2: What's fun is that you each answer separately. For example, you may find out that your partner wants a husky when you had a dachshund in mind. That keeps a good part of the evening busy!
section1.p3: The quizzes about your future together are here all year round. The seasonal quizzes move to the top of the page when their time comes. The Halloween quizzes are at the top in October. The Christmas ones arrive in mid-November, and that's when you can find out whether your couple has been good this year or which Christmas duo you make. You can still play them the rest of the year.

section2.title: And after these quizzes?
section2.p1: Once you've been through all these quizzes, you can carry on with the games to play as a couple all year round. For example, there are the “would you rather” dilemmas or truth or dare. And if you want a real answer about your relationship, there's a test for that too.

section3.title: How to play
section3.p1: All these quizzes play the same way. Together, the first person answers all the questions and then passes the phone. The second person answers without seeing the first one's answers. You can also play on your own.
section3.p2: In the quizzes about your future together and in the Christmas ones, you get a single result for your couple. The quiz also gives you the list of questions where you don't agree. In the Halloween quizzes, each of you gets your own result. They also have a remote mode so you can each play on your own phone.
section3.p3: You don't have an account to create and there's nothing to install. Your answers aren't saved, they stay on your phone.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes, they're all free. There's no sign-up and no app to install. You play them right on your phone.
faq.q2: Do you have to be two?
faq.a2: Not necessarily. Almost all the quizzes can be played on your own or as a couple. Only the supervillain duo quiz needs two players. They're still more fun together, because you can compare your answers.
faq.q3: What happens to the quizzes once the season is over?
faq.a3: They stay on this page, a bit further down. Nothing gets deleted, so you can very well take a Halloween quiz in March.
faq.a4: Yes, there are two. “Naughty or nice?” tells you which of Santa's lists your couple is on and who is the nicer one. The Christmas characters quiz gives you the duo you make, for example Santa and Mrs. Claus. They're at the top of this page from mid-November to the end of December.
faq.a5: Yes, for the Halloween quizzes. One of you creates the game and the other joins with a code. Then you each answer on your own phone. The other quizzes are played on a single phone that you pass to each other.

futur.intro: These quizzes are about your future, for example the dog you'll have or the house you'll live in. You each answer separately and the quiz looks for the result that suits your couple best.

vous.intro: These quizzes are about your relationship as it is today, for example who decides at your place. You can take them on your own or take turns on the same phone.
